overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried muskmelon powder for global food and beverage production. Processed from sun-ripened muskmelons grown in India, this fine powder preserves the authentic aroma and natural melon profile. Our advanced spray drying technology yields a uniform texture that disperses smoothly into formulations. As an FSSAI-registered supplier, we ensure consistent purity, low moisture, and reliable processing across commercial batches.

Operating as an IEC-registered exporter, we support international trade with full export documentation and reliable logistics. We manage a thorough six-step production process, from sourcing and sorting through controlled drying and final inspection. Our muskmelon powder provides high solubility in water and dairy bases, serving industrial manufacturers, private label brands, and wholesale distributors seeking dependable fruit ingredients with custom packaging support.
highlights: Processed using advanced spray drying technology
Fine 80 to 100 mesh size for rapid solubility
Free from artificial colors and preservatives
applications: Instant beverage mixes and fruit shakes
Ice creams, popsicles, and frozen desserts
Dry blending mixes and fruit premixes

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for muskmelon powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating both pilot product formulations and commercial manufacturing volumes.

faqs.q: What packaging formats do you offer for bulk and retail supply?
faqs.a: We provide 25 kg bags, 25 kg HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and customized private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: How is your spray dried muskmelon powder produced?
faqs.a: Production follows a six-step method covering raw material sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled spray drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packaging.

faqs.q: Can buyers obtain product samples prior to bulk orders?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request to evaluate aroma, solubility, and performance in your production line.

faqs.q: What regulatory credentials and export support do you provide?
faqs.a: We are an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, providing complete export documentation support for international shipments.

faqs.q: Do you accommodate custom mesh sizes and private label requirements?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide full OEM and private labeling services, including custom particle sizing and specialized packaging solutions upon request.
